pending: Request clipboard + clock badge (awaiting). Use with the Caution role.
progress_activity: Request clipboard + open-arc spinner badge (in progress).
assignment_ind: Request clipboard with a person on it: the request is assigned to someone.
content_copy: Two stacked sheets: the front sheet copied from the one behind.
gallery: Stacked photos (the copy stack with a mountain and sun on the front sheet).
emergency_announcement: Rounded warning diamond with an exclamation mark (emergency).
priority_flag: Swallowtail flag on a pole. Level is shown by line/filled + colour role (see notes).
people: Two people, one standing slightly behind the other (team).
groups: Three people: one in front, two behind (a group).
line_end_square: A line that ends in a square (timeline end point).
start: A start bar with an arrow leaving it.
today: The shared calendar with one day block marked (today).
fullscreen: Four corner brackets pushed out to the edges.
support_agent: A head wearing a headset with a microphone (helpdesk agent).
videocam: Video camera: a body with a lens hood.
comment: Speech bubble with two lines of text (a written comment).
chat: Speech bubble with three dots (a conversation).
add_comment: Speech bubble with a plus (start a new chat).
user: Person (head and shoulders) inside a circle: the user's profile.
person_remove: A person with a minus beside them (remove member).
filter_applied: The shared filter funnel with a dot badge: a filter is applied.
request_quote: Two quotation marks (a quote), matching the old app icon.
admin_panel_settings: A person inside a shield: the group admin (protected role).
